input: Hello, I manage catering for a school meals provider serving hot lunches to six primary schools in Cork, and I need to sign one autumn-term supply contract for pork sausages. Requirements: Irish pork with at least 65% pork content, a gluten-free recipe, around 120 kg per week delivered to our Cork kitchen on Mondays before 7am, Bord Bia QA (a tender requirement), and up to €13 per kg. We want proper Irish quality-assured sausages carrying the label parents trust, good-quality Irish pork from a reliable, well-known supplier. Please sign with the best option. Many thanks

experiences.name: Fingal Rooster Potatoes — Weekly Supply
experiences.description: Floury Irish Rooster potatoes, ideal for smooth school-kitchen mash. Grown in North County Dublin, washed and delivered in 25 kg sacks.

experiences.name: Muskerry Organic Pork — Bord Bia QA & Certified Organic Gluten-Free Sausages
experiences.description: Bord Bia Quality Assured and certified organic Irish pork. Certification: Bord Bia Quality Assured • Certified organic (Irish Organic Association). Gluten-free sausages, 70% pork from organic farms in West Cork, made in Macroom and supplied in chilled 5 kg packs; Monday 6am delivery for 120 kg weekly volumes. Outdoor access required; straw-bedded housing with minimum space allowances; no routine tail docking.

experiences.name: Lee Valley Meats — Bord Bia QA Premium Gluten-Free Pork Sausages
experiences.description: Bord Bia Quality Assured Irish pork, trusted by Irish families for 40 years. Certification: Bord Bia Quality Assured (Sustainable Pig Assurance Scheme). Premium gluten-free sausages, 70% pork from Cork and Tipperary farms, made in Mallow and supplied in chilled 5 kg packs; Monday 6am delivery for 120 kg weekly volumes. Pigs housed indoors on slatted floors; no outdoor access.

experiences.name: Leeside Catering — Reduced-Sugar Baked Beans
experiences.description: Reduced-sugar baked beans in tomato sauce, a school-lunch staple. 2.6 kg catering tins, delivered Mondays from our Cork wholesale depot.

experiences.name: Comeragh Organic Farm Foods — Bord Bia QA & Certified Organic Gluten-Free Sausages
experiences.description: Bord Bia Quality Assured; certified organic Irish pork. Certification: Bord Bia Quality Assured • Certified organic (Organic Trust). Gluten-free sausages, 67% pork from organic farms in Waterford, made in Dungarvan and supplied in chilled 5 kg packs; Monday 6:30am delivery for 120 kg weekly volumes. Outdoor access required; straw-bedded housing with minimum space allowances; no routine tail docking.

experiences.name: Blackwater Butchers Co. — Bord Bia QA Traditional Irish Pork Sausages
experiences.description: Traditional Irish pork sausages from an Origin Green verified member. Certification: Bord Bia Quality Assured • Origin Green (sustainability programme). Gluten-free, 68% pork from Waterford farms, made in Fermoy and supplied in chilled 5 kg packs; Monday 6:30am delivery for 120 kg weekly volumes. Pigs housed indoors on slatted floors; no outdoor access.

experiences.name: Shannon Green Gluten-Free Plant-Based Sausages
experiences.description: Gluten-free plant-based sausages for school menus, available in 120 kg weekly volumes. Made in Limerick from Irish-milled pea protein and supplied in chilled packs.
